title: On the Farm
description: Three short recordings about a farm: animals, a farmer's morning and a ride.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Farm animals
parts.intro: You will hear Anna and her grandpa.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Grandpa, I see a cow!

script.speaker: Grandpa
script.text: Yes, her name is Daisy. She is black and white.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: How many chickens do you have?

script.speaker: Grandpa
script.text: I have six chickens.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Where are the pigs?

script.speaker: Grandpa
script.text: The sheep are in the barn. The pigs are in the mud. Pigs love mud.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: I like the farm, Grandpa. The animals are so nice.

script.speaker: Grandpa
script.text: I'm happy you like it. Now let's have milk and bread.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Yes, please. I'm hungry.

parts.title: Part 2 · A farmer's morning
parts.intro: You will hear a farmer, Mrs Lan.

script.speaker: Mrs Lan
script.text: Good morning. I am a farmer. Every morning I give food to the horses. They like carrots.

script.speaker: Mrs Lan
script.text: Then I get eggs from the chickens.

script.speaker: Mrs Lan
script.text: Then I give water to the sheep.

script.speaker: Mrs Lan
script.text: After that, I clean the barn. I like my work, and I like the animals.

script.speaker: Mrs Lan
script.text: In the evening, I go home and eat dinner with my family.

parts.title: Part 3 · The tractor
parts.intro: You will hear Tom and Mai.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Look at the big tractor!

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: It's red. Can we ride in the tractor?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: No, it is too dangerous. But we can ride the horse.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Yes, please!

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: The horse is brown and very kind. His name is Star.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Hello, Star! Let's give him an apple, Tom.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Good idea. Then we can go for a ride.
